verdict.rationale: The evidence covers per-second billing, credit and auto-pay mechanics, a REST API for compute resources, and a CLI that can 'view account information'. None of it documents a programmatic usage or billing endpoint, or any breakdown of spend by team, project, or workload. Account-information viewing and compute-management APIs are adjacent features, not cost-attribution capabilities.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can pull usage and billing breakdowns programmatically to attribute GPU spend by team or workload
